newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Finnish 1997 GDP seen rising 3.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Finnish 1997 GDP seen rising 3.9 pct.

text.p: Finnish GDP will grow nearly four percent in 1997, inflation will speed up but remain a modest 1.5 percent and the current account will again show a hefty surplus, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.

The ministry's new 1996-97 economic forecast, a revision of its previous projection published in May, forms the base for the five-party government's 1997 state budget proposal sent to parliament on Tuesday..

The ministry assumed that growth in the European Union area -- a key market for Finnish exports -- would be 2.5 percent in 1997 and average growth in OECD countries would be slightly above two percent.

The targetted deficit/GDP ratio to qualify for EMU is below 3.0 percent, and the debt/GDP ceiling is 60 percent. Entrants will be chosen in spring 1998 based on economic performance in 1997. --Helsinki Newsroom +358 - 0 - 680 50 245
